Companion Animal Travel Desk Basics for New Travelers

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps pet travel simple, calm, and organized. Start here if you are bringing an animal on a trip and want the process handled with care. The desk team checks the basics, points out the next steps, and helps you move through the airport without rushing your animal.

Bring your travel papers, your pet's carrier, and any items the desk asks for before you arrive. Keep the carrier secure and easy to open for inspection. Handlers use calm, humane methods, and they focus on safety before speed. That approach helps reduce stress for both you and your animal.

If you are traveling through Merrowgate, <<FACT F017>>. The desk will guide you toward the right area and explain how to use it without crowding your pet or delaying your trip. Stay close to the instructions, and keep your animal leashed or contained unless staff ask you to do otherwise.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F001>>. The desk will also point out how to make the lounge visit smooth, especially if your pet needs a quiet pause before boarding. Keep your tone steady, follow the staff lead, and let them handle any adjustments that are needed.

If you are unsure about what to bring or how to prepare, ask the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you leave for the airport. The team is there to keep the journey safe, clear, and manageable from start to finish.
